SES-001.scenario: Check that the Change password page shows the three password fields, the password rule and both buttons
SES-001.preconditions: Admin user is signed in to the console.
steps: Click Change password in the side menu.
Check that the fields Current password, New password and Confirm new password are shown.
Check that the rule text '8 to 12 characters' is shown.
Check that the buttons 'Change password and sign in again' and 'Back to the console' are shown.
Type in each password field and check that the characters are hidden (masked).
SES-001.expected: All three fields, the rule text and both buttons are visible, and all three password fields hide what is typed.

SES-002.scenario: Check that submitting the Change password form with all fields empty shows a message under each field
SES-002.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Leave Current password, New password and Confirm new password empty.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
Read the message under each field.
SES-002.expected: Current password shows 'Enter your current password', New password shows 'Use at least 8 characters', Confirm shows 'Type the new password again', and no change-password request is sent.

SES-003.scenario: Check that a new password that breaks the length or complexity rule is refused with the matching message
SES-003.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Type 'Current@1' in Current password.
Type the weak password in New password and the same value in Confirm new password.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
Read the message under New password.
SES-003.test_data: Variants: 'Ab@1xyz' (7 chars); 'Abcd@12345678' (13 chars); 'ABCD@1234' (no lowercase); 'abcd@1234' (no uppercase); 'Abcd@xyzw' (no digit); 'Abcd12345' (no symbol)
SES-003.expected: 7 chars shows 'Use at least 8 characters'; 13 chars shows 'Use at most 12 characters'; the others show 'Include a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit and a symbol'. No change-password request is sent.

SES-004.scenario: Verify that new passwords of exactly 8 and exactly 12 characters pass the on-screen rule check
SES-004.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page. The request to the server is intercepted so the real password is not changed.
steps: Type 'Current@1' in Current password.
Type the boundary-length password in New password and Confirm new password.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
Check the message under New password and whether the request was sent.
SES-004.expected: No rule message is shown under New password and exactly one change-password request is sent to the server.

SES-005.scenario: Check that New password and Confirm new password must match
SES-005.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Type 'Current@1' in Current password.
Type 'Abcd@1234' in New password.
Type 'Abcd@9999' in Confirm new password.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
SES-005.test_data: Current: Current@1 / New: Abcd@1234 / Confirm: Abcd@9999
SES-005.expected: 'The two passwords do not match' is shown under Confirm new password and no change-password request is sent.

SES-006.sub_module: Change password – reuse of current password
SES-006.scenario: Check that the new password cannot be the same as the current password
SES-006.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Type 'Abcd@1234' in Current password.
Type 'Abcd@1234' in New password and Confirm new password.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
Read the message under New password.
SES-006.test_data: Current: Abcd@1234 / New: Abcd@1234 / Confirm: Abcd@1234
SES-006.expected: 'Choose a password you have not used here before' is shown under New password.

SES-007.scenario: Verify that the server refuses a password change when the current password is wrong
SES-007.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Type a wrong current password 'Wrong@Cur1'.
Type a valid new password 'Qa@New1234' in New password and Confirm new password.
Click 'Change password and sign in again'.
Check the server response and the message on the form.
SES-007.test_data: Current: Wrong@Cur1 (wrong) / New and Confirm: Qa@New1234
SES-007.expected: The server refuses the change with a client error (4xx, not success and not a server crash), an error message is shown under the form, and the user stays signed in on the Change password page.

SES-008.sub_module: Change password – Back to the console
SES-008.scenario: Check that 'Back to the console' leaves the Change password page without changing anything
SES-008.preconditions: Admin user is signed in and on the Change password page.
steps: Open the Change password page.
Click 'Back to the console'.
SES-008.expected: The user is taken away from the Change password page back into the console.

SES-010.scenario: Verify that Sign out returns to the sign-in page, clears the browser session and makes the old token unusable on the server
SES-010.preconditions: Admin user is signed in with a fresh, separate session in a clean browser.
steps: Note the current session token kept by the browser tab.
Click Sign out in the side menu.
Wait for the sign-in page to load.
Check that the tab no longer holds the session.
Using the old token, call the API GET /auth/me (current user details).
SES-010.test_data: The access token from before sign out
SES-010.expected: The user lands on the sign-in page, the tab session is removed, and the API answers HTTP 401 (unauthorised) for the old token.

SES-011.scenario: Check that pressing the browser Back button after signing out does not show console data
SES-011.preconditions: Admin user is signed in with a fresh, separate session in a clean browser.
steps: Open the Beneficiary List page.
Click Sign out in the side menu.
Wait for the sign-in page.
Press the browser Back button.
SES-011.expected: The user stays on (or is sent back to) the sign-in page and no beneficiary list data is shown.

SES-012.sub_module: Sign out – protected page by URL
SES-012.scenario: Check that typing a console page address after signing out leads to the sign-in page
SES-012.preconditions: Admin user is signed in with a fresh, separate session in a clean browser.
steps: Click Sign out in the side menu.
Wait for the sign-in page.
Type the address of the Beneficiaries page (/beneficiaries) in the browser and open it.
SES-012.expected: The user is redirected to the sign-in page instead of seeing the Beneficiaries page.
